dataset_name: Real EO feature grid (Sentinel-2 L2A, MODIS MOD11A2, NASADEM)
provider: ESA Copernicus / NASA / USGS via Microsoft Planetary Computer

rationale.NDVI: (B08-B04)/(B08+B04); vegetation cover masks or reflects substrate
rationale.Iron_Oxide_Index: B04/B02; ferric oxide staining of weathered surfaces
rationale.LST_Day_K: MODIS daytime LST; thermal inertia / exposed rock vs soil
rationale.slope: NASADEM mean slope; resistant ridges vs pediplains
rationale.NDRE: (B8A-B05)/(B8A+B05); red-edge vegetation stress over mineralised ground
rationale.SWIR_Albedo: (B11+B12)/2; dark Mn oxides (pyrolusite/psilomelane) lower SWIR reflectance
rationale.elevation_sd: SD of 1-arcsec NASADEM elevation inside the cell; local ruggedness

sentinel2.composite: per-pixel temporal median, indices computed on the composite

modis_lst.qc_rule: QC_Day bits0-1 == 0, or bits0-1 == 1 and bits6-7 <= 1 (error <= 2 K)
modis_lst.spatial_sampling: nearest MODIS pixel to the cell centre

dem.elevation_sd: standard deviation of 1-arcsec elevation within the cell (m)

recipe.cell_aggregation: Sentinel-2 and NASADEM: mean of pixels whose centre falls in the 0.01 degree cell; MODIS LST: nearest 1 km pixel to the cell centre

native_resolution: S2 read at 200 m, NASADEM 30 m, MODIS 1 km; aggregated to 0.01 degree cells
